Our locations

Fresh tea, made to order, at four shops around the Bay. Every shop is open seven days a week. Holiday hours may differ; follow us for news. We source our leaves from small farms in Taiwan and Japan and brew every batch by hand, several times a day, so the tea you drink is never more than a few hours old.

Large orders: call any shop a day ahead and we will have them ready when you arrive. Catering and gift cards are available at every location. Ask about our loyalty card, and the seasonal drinks that come and go.
